purpose: Declarative contract for the V2 minimum Skill collection. It fixes 0..N skill semantics, package source, version/hash, independent enable/disable, reload timing and context isolation. It contains no secrets and no fixed runtime port.

skills.emptySetMeaning: no skills available; the agent still runs
skills.source: skills/public/ + per-user custom + integrations + legacy; enabled state read from extensions_config.json:skills plus per-user skill state

package.unit: whole skill directory, not just SKILL.md
package.packageBoundary: a nested SKILL.md is not registered as a separate runtime skill; the directory is the package boundary

agentSelection.listMeaning: only the listed skills are selectable
agentSelection.enforcement: an explicit skill list (including []) is intersected with enabled public/user-visible skills at sandbox projection; None keeps the shared mount
agentSelection.negativeIf: null is treated as none, or [] is treated as all

enableDisable.negative: a disabled Golden Scenario skill must not be activated and must not change agent behavior

reload.timing: subsequent runs rescan; active runs keep their existing snapshot
reload.negative: reload must not require a restart to pick up a newly enabled skill for new runs

contextIsolation.requirement: a skill only affects the run/turn in which it is activated; it must not leak its instructions or resources into an unrelated run or another user's context
contextIsolation.negativeIf: enabling or activating v2-format-control changes the output of a run that selected only consulting-analysis

activation.mechanism: SKILL.md is actually read and its instructions/resources change agent behavior

scopeBoundary.chartPolicy: if no visualization skill is available, use comparison tables and note the absence of charts; charts are optional
scopeBoundary.missingP0Policy: note missing P0 data explicitly in the report rather than fabricating it

skills.name: v2-format-control
skills.purpose: exercise independent enable/disable, version/hash, reload and context isolation; it must never be presented as an upstream skill

requiredContractCases.assertion: at least 2 skills are discovered from distinct package sources
disabling v2-format-control leaves consulting-analysis enabled and activatable
each skill records source, license and a version or content hash
a newly enabled skill is available to subsequent runs after POST /api/skills/reload without restart
activating one skill does not change an unrelated run's skills or instructions
consulting-analysis activation is proven by a real behavior change, not by file presence
